objectives: Plan rigorous and ethical physics research.
Develop reproducible analysis and effective scientific communication.

outcomes.statement: Formulate a focused research question from the literature.
Design a reproducible research and data-management workflow.
Evaluate evidence, uncertainty and research ethics.
Communicate results in written and oral formats.

syllabus.title: Research Design
syllabus.topics: Questions, hypotheses, literature review, project planning and research ethics.

syllabus.title: Reproducible Analysis
syllabus.topics: Data management, version control, computational notebooks and uncertainty.

syllabus.title: Scientific Communication
syllabus.topics: Papers, proposals, visualisation, presentations and peer review.
